prompt: Use the GDT layout from the lesson (null, kernel code, kernel data, user data, user code, then the 16-byte TSS descriptor).

trace.label: [selector] for user code, loaded into `cs` in ring 3
[access] byte of the user data segment (present, DPL 3, data, writable)
[access] byte of the TSS descriptor after `ltr 0x28` has run
[size] field of the pointer passed to `gdt_flush`

explain: User code is GDT slot 4 (offset 0x20); a ring 3 selector adds RPL 3 in the low bits, giving 0x23. Setting both DPL bits turns data 0x92 into 0xF2. `ltr` marks the TSS busy by changing type 9 to type 11 (0x89 to 0x8B) in your table. Five 8-byte entries plus the 16-byte TSS descriptor make 56 bytes, and the size field is one less: 55.
